test_name: Verify User Login via Google Integration
description: Tests the ability of a user to log in using Google authentication and ensures successful redirection to the dashboard.
steps: Verify the visibility of the Google login button.
Click on the Google login button.
Wait for the Google account selection interface to load.
Confirm authentication via the Google interface.
Verify redirection to the https://dev.roost.ai dashboard.
Assert the presence of user-specific elements on the dashboard.
expected_results: User is successfully authenticated via Google.
User is redirected to the dashboard.
edge_cases: Google login button is not visible.
Authentication fails due to incorrect Google account credentials.
User is not redirected to the dashboard post-authentication.
Google account selection interface fails to load.
data_requirements: Access to the Google authentication interface.
User account registered with Roost platform.
dependencies: Roost platform backend is functioning correctly.
User has an active Google account linked to Roost.
api_interactions: Roost backend API for user session creation.
Dashboard API to fetch user-specific data.
performance_metrics: Time taken for Google authentication interface to load.
Loading time for user-specific elements on the dashboard.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the Google login button is labeled appropriately for screen readers.
Verify color contrast ratios for the button.
Test keyboard accessibility for the login button.
